schedules.description: Edits at 0/30/80 ms coalesce at the final 120 ms deadline.
A later burst receives a fresh quiet interval.
Closing at 20 ms saves A before return and retires A's badge.
Opening B at 20 ms saves A under A's key, then B remains independently editable.
Closing and reopening A restores the last text without retaining the old batch.
Preview retains its authorized quiet interval.
A hidden preview can schedule a fresh query.

counterfactual_pairs.changed_relation: A new burst starts after the first deadline instead of extending the active batch.
Another document is installed after the same departure flush.
The departed document key is opened again as a new view.
Hide occurs before the quiet deadline and retires transient work.
A fresh query is enqueued after the hidden batch is discarded.
